units.source_text: 她就来到二女公子房中，极口称赞匂亲王不置。

en.t: She then came to the Second Princess's room and could not stop praising Prince Niou to the skies.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得此人有些乡下人气，笑着听她讲。

en.t: The Second Princess thought there was something rather provincial about the woman, and listened to her with a smile.

units.source_text: 她对二女公子言道：“当年夫人逝世之时，您还幼小得很呢。

en.t: The woman said to the Second Princess, "When your lady mother passed away, you were still very young.

units.source_text: 亲王和身边的人都忧愁叹息，担心您的前途如何是好。

en.t: The prince and everyone around him grieved and sighed, wondering what would become of you.

units.source_text: 全靠您宿世命好，在那山乡的怀抱之中也能顺利地长大成人。

en.t: It was entirely thanks to the good fortune you carried from former lives that you were able to grow up safely even in that mountain village.

units.source_text: 可惜的是大小姐早年夭折，真乃遗憾之事！”

en.t: What a pity that the elder young lady died so early; it was truly a sorrowful thing!"

units.source_text: 说罢流下泪来。

en.t: When she had said this, she began to shed tears.

units.source_text: 二女公子也啜泣了，答道：“人生于世，常有可恨可悲之事。

en.t: The Second Princess also sobbed and replied, "In human life, there are always things to resent and things to grieve over.

units.source_text: 但念自己犹能长生在世，有时亦可稍稍慰情。

en.t: Yet when I think that I myself have still been able to live on in this world, at times my heart is somewhat comforted.

units.source_text: 我所依靠的父母先我而死，原是世之常例。

en.t: That the parents I depended on should die before me is, after all, the usual way of the world.

units.source_text: 尤其是母亲，我连面貌也不知道，故悲哀之情也有限度。

en.t: As for my mother especially, I do not even know her face, so there is a limit to the grief I can feel.

units.source_text: 惟有姐姐夭折，使我非常伤心，永远不能忘怀。

en.t: Only my sister's early death has caused me deep sorrow, and I can never forget it.

units.source_text: 薰大将为她悲伤，千方百计也无法慰藉，足见此君富于深情，使我更加悼惜不已了。”

en.t: General Kaoru grieved for her, and no effort could console him; seeing how deeply feeling he is makes me mourn her all the more."

units.source_text: 中将君说：“薰大将招了驸马，皇帝恩宠之深厚世无其例，想必骄矜满志了。

en.t: Chujo no Kimi said, "General Kaoru has been chosen as an imperial son-in-law, and the Emperor's favor toward him is without equal, so he must surely be proud and satisfied.

units.source_text: 如果大小姐在世，恐怕也不能阻止他当驸马吧。”

en.t: Even if the elder young lady were alive, she probably could not have kept him from becoming an imperial son-in-law."

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“这也难说。

en.t: The Second Princess said, "That is hard to say.

units.source_text: 如果这样，我姐妹两人同样命运，更加惹人耻笑，倒不如早点死了的好。

en.t: If that were so, then we two sisters would have shared the same fate and become even more of a laughingstock; it would have been better to die early instead.

units.source_text: 人早死了受人悼念，原是世之常情。

en.t: When people die young, others naturally mourn them; that is simply the ordinary feeling of the world.

units.source_text: 可是这薰大将不知何故，异乎寻常地永不忘怀，连父亲死后的超荐功德等事也深切关怀，热心照顾呢。”

en.t: But for some reason this General Kaoru has remembered her with extraordinary constancy, and even after Father's death he has shown deep concern and devoted care for the memorial rites and offerings."

units.source_text: 她们谈得很亲切。

en.t: They spoke together very warmly and intimately.
